name: Airengy Tech Ltd.
summary: Augwind Energy Tech Storage Ltd is dedicated to pioneering alternative approaches to energy storage. The company's primary offering, AirBattery, is an advanced energy storage system that integrates both pumped hydro and compressed air technologies, specifically designed to facilitate the integration of renewable energy into grids. Furthermore, Augwind provides AirSmart, an energy efficiency system engineered for a wide range of industrial applications. Founded in 2012, Augwind Energy Tech Storage Ltd operates from its headquarters in Israel.
